payload.title: Collect public HN discoveries into a private review queue without classifier access
payload.description: As an editor, I want recurring public HN collection and a private source-linked review batch so I can rate discoveries while classifier integration remains disabled. This is explicitly local collection/review staging, not publication routing, Reference intake, or applied learning. Existing 18 received labels must remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Feature: Private collection without app authentication. Scenario: Collect and resume review. Given a private HN queue and a bounded source feed When scheduled collection repeats and a source is revised Then canonical sources are deduplicated and every discovery revision retains provenance And a private review batch is available with no cloud, model, training or label calls. Scenario: Respect source cadence and recover failures. Given a prior successful batch When collection is requested early or the source fails Then early collection does not fetch and failure remains visible without deleting the prior queue. Human feedback remains received only; no invented ratings or automatic publication assignment.
